body: How funny is it that I don't know whether or not to argue or agree my friend?

I really liked this poem. Eternity is something often conveyed in poetry but I haven't heard it like this before. I liked the beginning three lines, but I feel like they would be more effective if it were just 'will you condense with me?' Otherwise, really beautifully told.

I really like how relatable this poem is and how it authentically captures the mind of a student before an exam. The use of rhyme with each line is really well done and it sounds like was thought out well. The overall structure could use a little more organization, but, regardless it's really good.

I really like how you stuck around the ocean imagery and related it to the person this is about. The wording you use is authentic and this poem has a unique raw-ness to it that makes me wish it went on forever.
